filters: Use active-row and source-specified marketplace filters; scope fields remain columns/caveats only.
formula_text:
SELECT
  return_type,
  return_sub_type,
  courier_partner,
  COUNT(*) AS returns,
  SUM(qty) AS units_returned
FROM zs_observe.meesho_returns
WHERE is_active = true
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY returns DESC;
